GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

13. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
